head.title: Affordable instalment loans
head.body: Borrow £1,000 to £5,000 and choose your repayments over a period of up to 36 months, to suit your circumstances.

cards.title: How much can I borrow?
cards.body: We base the amount you can borrow on your monthly income, plus any other regular monthly income, with a minimum loan of £1,000 up to a maximum loan of £5,000. We can lend up to 2× your income — including salary, self-employed income and pensions.

cards.title: Fixed, predictable repayments
cards.body: Your repayments are fixed throughout the term of the loan, so you know at the outset exactly what you’ll pay each month. Before you sign the agreement you will always know what you will repay and the terms.

applyBand.title: Apply today — easy as one, two, funded.
steps: Click ‘Start your application’ and tell us your loan amount, repayment term and some personal details.
Using the details you supply, we run checks to see if we can accept your application.
Sign, verify your online banking, and we’ll be in touch for a quick 5–10 minute call to discuss monthly repayments.

faqLinkHtml: For our full list of FAQs, see our help & support page.
noticeHtml: Important note: late repayments can lead to serious money problems. For debt counselling advice please visit moneyhelper.org.uk.
